cards.text: Zechariah is a prophet (Zechariah 1:1), and he's just seen four chariots ride out in a vision (Zechariah 6:1-8). Now the word of the LORD comes to him again. No horses this time, friend, just a job to do.

Step one: take an offering from Heldai, Tobijah and Jedaiah, three exiles who have arrived from Babylon. That's a LONG trip, friend, and the longest trip I ever took was across a kitchen and into the back of a JUNK DRAWER.

cards.question: God tells Zechariah to take the offering from the exiles and go that same day to someone's house. Whose house?

cards.text: Next, God tells Zechariah to take silver and gold and make an ornate crown. The fanciest thing that's ever been on MY head is a chef's hat, and half the time it's covered in FLOUR.

cards.question: God says to set the silver and gold crown on the head of the high priest. Whose head is that?

cards.text: That crown is for Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Then Zechariah is to tell him what the LORD of Hosts says: 'Here is a man whose name is the Branch, and He will branch out from His place…'

cards.question: The man called the Branch will branch out from His place. Then what will He do? He will build the ___ of the LORD.

cards.text: Then it comes AGAIN: 'Yes, He will build the temple of the LORD; He will be clothed in splendor and will sit on His throne and rule.' A builder AND a ruler, friend, and meanwhile I lose arguments with my own oven timer.

cards.question: The Branch will sit on His throne and rule. What else will He be, right there on that throne?
The Branch will rule on His throne, and He'll be a priest on His throne. True or false: God says there will be bitter rivalry between the two.

cards.text: The crown will reside in the temple of the LORD as a memorial to Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah and the gracious son of Zephaniah. The family that owned me only carved my name into my handle, but these folks get remembered with a CROWN.

cards.question: Then the message looks ahead to who will build the temple of the LORD. True or false: even people far away will come and build it.

cards.text: Then the message says, '…you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me to you.' But hold up, friend, because there's an IF.

cards.question: The message ends with an IF, and it's about the voice of the LORD their God. All this will happen if they diligently ___ it.
